Assessment.content: Viral upper respiratory infection versus early influenza

Illness characterized by 4 days of sore throat (improving), nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, dry cough, initial fever improving, night sweats, myalgias, fatigue, and mild dyspnea on exertion without chest pain and with normal breathing at rest
